sanskrit_verse: ब्रह्मचारी चरेद् भैक्षमधःशायी अनलङ्कृतः । जघन्यशायी सर्वेषां पूर्वोत्थायी गुरोः गृहे ॥
transliteration: brahmacārī cared bhaikṣam adhaḥśāyy analaṅkṛtaḥ | jaghanyaśāyī sarveṣām pūrvotthāyī guroḥ gṛhe ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The celibate student shall seek alms without pride, sleep on the ground unadorned, occupy the lowest seat among all, and rise before the Guru in his house.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from Guru to disciple through disciplined service
Causation arises from intentional alignment with dharma-sattva
Capacity-based responsibility requires renunciation of comfort for spiritual growth
Restoration logic centers on purification of conduct and humility
Consciousness alignment manifests through surrender to Guru's temporal and spiritual order
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning spiritual discipline or educational hierarchy, precedence is given to established Guru-disciple constitutional order; personal comfort or social status cannot override institutional dharmic structure.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that improper conduct stems from misaligned consciousness, not inherent fault; correction follows anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential purification via regulated behavior; no punitive action taken, only realignment of posture, timing, and intention.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Assign reorientation tasks involving early rising and floor sleeping
Implement supervised alms-seeking under Guru guidance
Introduce daily reflection sessions on humility and service
Reinstate proper seating protocol until integrity naturally restored
Monitor behavioral sequence recalibration through bi-daily compliance check-ins
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this directive originates as pure Dharma-sattva, restoring consciousness alignment through right action, affirming Guru-parampara as judicial foundation, rejecting punitive frameworks, upholding reality as inherently non-punitive, where consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
